meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Indian skin par **white cast na chhodne ke liye chemical ya lightweight hybrid sunscreen** sabse achha rahega—mineral sunscreens mein zinc oxide/titanium dioxide ke kaaran cast zyada dikh sakta hai.[1][2]

**Meri top recommendation:**  
- **Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++** — fragrance-free, lightweight aur medium-to-deep Indian skin tones par generally invisible finish deta hai.[3]  
- **Oily/acne-prone skin:** **Dot & Key Waterlight Gel SPF 50** ya **Neutrogena Ultra Sheer**—light texture, lekin Neutrogena kuch logon ko thoda drying lag sakta hai.[4]  
- **Dry/normal skin:** **Plum SPF 50 PA++++**—lightweight, no-white-cast finish.[5]  
- **Tinted option:** **Lakmé Sun Expert Tinted Sunscreen SPF 50**—tint white cast ko cover karta hai aur Indian skin tones ke liye suitable bataya gaya hai.[1]

**Kaise choose karein:** SPF 50, broad-spectrum protection aur preferably **PA++++** dekhein. Pehle jawline par natural daylight mein test karein; sunscreen ki lagbhag **do-finger quantity** face aur neck ke liye lagayein, aur outdoor exposure mein har 2 ghante reapply karein.[3]

Agar ek hi naam chahiye: **Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++** se shuru karein.
